mainEntity.name: Do you manage converted three-flats and small condo buildings in Wicker Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Much of Wicker Park's condo stock is vintage two-to-six-flat conversions, and our flat monthly fee starting at $20 per unit is designed so buildings that size get professional management, transparent books, and 24/7 emergency coverage without big-building overhead.

mainEntity.name: Our building sits above retail on Milwaukee Avenue — can Stellar manage it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We manage mixed-use condominium buildings and handle the extra layers they involve: cost allocations with commercial owners, shared building systems, and operating rules that keep the residential floors livable above active storefronts.

mainEntity.name: Does Stellar Property Management serve Wicker Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Stellar Property Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Wicker Park, Chicago (ZIP 60622, 60647), backed by a Chicago office that has served area communities since 2007 — 29 associations and approximately 1,422 residences under management, with a 96% client retention rate since 2007.

mainEntity.name: What types of community associations does Stellar manage in Wicker Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar's association-management model is designed for condominiums, townhomes, HOAs in Wicker Park. Every client community receives a dedicated property manager, transparent monthly financial reporting, 24/7 live emergency response, and board support informed by applicable Illinois association requirements.

mainEntity.name: How much does association management cost in Wicker Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar management starts at $20 per unit per month. We quote a customized flat monthly fee based on your Wicker Park association's size, amenities, staffing, financial complexity, and service scope — never a percentage of your budget. We do not add a separate capital-project planning or management-oversight fee. Third-party professional and contractor costs remain association expenses.

mainEntity.name: How do we switch our Wicker Park association to Stellar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switching is a managed 30–60 day transition: once your board signs, we retrieve records from the outgoing firm, migrate banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open your board and resident portals. Call 773.728.0652 or request a proposal online to start.

mainEntity.name: How should a Wicker Park board choose a condo or HOA management company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois management firm license, a credentialed manager (CMCA, AMS or PCAM), a flat monthly fee in writing, who answers emergencies at night, and how records move during the transition. Stellar Property Management is a licensed Chicago firm (license #291000211) that has managed associations since 2007, publishes its pricing, and answers emergencies with a live person 24/7. Boards in Wicker Park can score any proposals side by side with Stellar's free comparison tool at stellarpropertygroup.com/tools/compare-management-proposals.
